task: Make DONE merge rebuild the local main CLI dist when packages/main runtime inputs changed.
outcome: After a story touching packages/main/src reaches DONE, the terminal output includes a post-DONE CLI rebuild line such as `✓ packages/main build refreshed after DONE merge`, and immediately running `lattice help` from main shows the newly merged command instead of stale dist output.
facts: Global lattice on this machine resolves to packages/main/dist/cli.js through the npm symlink.
TypeScript source changes under packages/main/src do not update dist until npm --prefix packages/main run build is executed.
applyDoneMergeEffects already runs after story branch merge into local main and before worktree cleanup/report completion.
docs-only stories should not pay a rebuild cost if CLI runtime inputs did not change.
Decision chose a targeted changed-path rebuild hook with helper-level smoke coverage rather than unconditional rebuild or hook-only reminders.
constraints: Do not change remote push or release approval policy.
Do not publish or reinstall global packages automatically.
The rebuild must be tied to DONE merge effects, not a remembered manual shell habit.
If rebuild fails after merge, the user must receive explicit recovery guidance instead of silently assuming dist is fresh.
